_comment: Sunset Pools, Rydalmere NSW. Built by hand: www.sunsetpools.com.au sits behind a Cloudflare challenge that npm run new cannot clear, so every fact here was read off their own pages through the Wayback Machine (latest capture 17 Apr 2026) and their photos came out of their own media library. Rating and reviews are from data/google_reviews_top25.json and nothing else. See BRIEF.md.

_source.readVia: web.archive.org. The live site answers HTTP 403 with 'cf-mitigated: challenge' (Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' interstitial) to `npm run new`, to curl with a browser UA and to a headless Chromium from this IP, so nothing was read from the live origin. Every page below was read from the Wayback Machine capture nearest 2026-04-17, raw (the /web/<ts>id_/ form), and every photo came from their own wp-content/uploads media library through the same route.
_source.aboutText:
Ben Thompson is the founder of Sunset Pools and at the core of a new generation of Australian pool design and construction specialists who have rejected outdated design and construction ideas. Ben favours creating one-off special designs and more adventurous pool concepts that form bespoke assets to their lucky owners leisure environment and lifestyle.

Ben repeatedly illustrates how in the hands of a creative pool designer reinforced concrete has virtually limitless possibilities. Results that have earned Sunset Pools many fans and a well-deserved reputation in addition to a stream of local and national swimming pool design, construction and renovation awards. Ben appreciates that reinforced concrete can be fashioned to create swimming pools and spas that reflect his client’s individuality, formed to complement their lifestyle, and finished to harmonise with their environment. In light of this versatility, Ben laments that it is difficult to understand why so many concrete pool construction contractors simply carry on offering the same half dozen basic pool shapes year after year.

As a multi-award winning builder at the top of his trade, Ben is established as Sydney’s pool, spa and water feature specialist of choice for discerning residents, astute strata managers, local authorities, resorts and prestigious international hotels where accurate estimating, sound administration and safe work practices are mandatory.

As important as a new pool’s aesthetic and high-quality finish are the design solutions you can’t actually see. Less evident but just as critical is Ben’s meticulous attention to each project’s structural and hydraulic engineering and choice of building materials.

As a consequence of Ben’s long-term fascination with creating the industry’s most effective pool and spa hydraulics, his informed selection of filtration, sanitation and environmentally sensitive heating technologies means that Sunset Pool owners can also look forward to the long-term benefits of selecting a Sunset pool and spa.

By adopting and adapting commercial-grade water filtration, heating and sanitation systems Ben’s hydraulic solutions have established an unsurpassed “Sunset standard” for pool and spa water management efficiency, monitoring and control. Attributes that Ben bestows on the swimming pool renovation projects his company undertakes as well as the new builds.

You will discover that Ben Thompson enjoys nothing more than collaborating with visionary individuals who can appreciate the added value his innovative approach can realise. Working with discerning Sydney homeowners their architects, engineers and builders Ben creates innovative and practical leisure solutions. Ben always remains directly involved throughout every stage of construction, project managing each aspect and trade to ensure uncompromised high-end results that literally reflect their proud owners sense of style.

notOnThePage: No founding year is published anywhere, so no year is claimed — only their own ‘over 20 years’.
No prices are published anywhere, so priceLines are absent and no figure is claimed.
‘over 500+ happy clients’ appears on their homepage and was deliberately left off this demo as an unverifiable round number.
A 10-year guarantee is mentioned once on /residential-pools/ (‘premium materials, guaranteed for ten years’) and was left off until Ben confirms it in writing.

No SMS button is on the page. The only number they publish is 1300 000 412, and an Australian 1300 cannot receive a text, so a “text Ben a photo” button would be a dead control. The message body is kept in `sms` so the buttons return the moment a mobile is added — see BRIEF.md, Ask Ben 7.

Anna Perrin’s Google review is the sixth in `best_for_demo` and is deliberately not on the page. Five reviews keep the marquee to a single row, which is what stops the same review being on screen twice at 1440; hers is the most general of the six, and the detail that carried it — that the job was ten years ago and they still look after it — is the part Google cuts off.

Fourth review pass (2026-09-23): cut or reworded every line that promised how Ben works, gave a reason for it, claimed a reputation, or overstated a job’s scope. Master Builders is a membership on their site, never a medal, so the recognition line names SPASA only. The licence is the business’s, not Ben’s personally. Strathfield, like Wentworth Point, is captioned as the filtration and plant room because that is how their portfolio labels it.

copy.title: Sunset Pools | Sydney Concrete Pool Builder, Renovations & Hydraulics
copy.description: Sunset Pools build and renovate concrete pools across Sydney — rooftop pools, indoor pools and sites other builders turn down. Ben Thompson runs every job himself. Licensed NSW pool builder 166547C.
copy.headline:
The pools other
builders call
too hard.
copy.sub: Ben Thompson builds and renovates concrete pools around Sydney — on rooftops, inside buildings, and 132 steps from the road. He brings meticulous attention to the structural and hydraulic engineering, and stays directly involved through every stage of the job.
copy.statementHeadline:
Anyone can
quote a pool.
The site is
the hard part.
copy.statementBody: Access, levels, soil and where the water has to go decide what a Sydney pool costs and whether it lasts. Ben has built pools on rooftops and indoors, and renovated one 132 steps from the road at Bellevue Hill.
copy.servicesIntro: Renovations, new pools — including the ones on a roof or inside a building — and the hydraulics behind both. On a rooftop the pool is the easy part; getting the weight, the water and the plant room up there is not. Ben project-manages each trade himself.
copy.workIntro: The filtration and plant room for a beach-entry pool at Wentworth Point, a lap pool inside a house at Strathfield, and a renovation 132 steps from the road. Tap any photo to see it larger.
copy.reviewsIntro: Straight from their Google profile, nothing reworded. Where one is marked shortened, only its opening is here and the rest is on Google. One of them first had Ben build a pool twelve years ago and has him back now for the next stage.
copy.recognitionHeadline:
Judged by the industry,
not by us.
copy.recognitionIntro: SPASA medals from chapter level up to national, and an international award for an indoor lap pool. Their full list runs from 2009 to 2016.
copy.areasIntro: Northern Beaches to the Shire, harbour to the inner west. Sunset Pools is Sydney-based and independent — it has no connection to the businesses using the same name interstate.
copy.enquireIntro: The more you can say about the block — the access, the levels, what is there now — the more useful the first call is. Photos help more than anything — email them in with your enquiry.

faq.q: Can you work on a block with difficult access?
faq.a: Sunset have. One Bellevue Hill renovation had 132 steps between the road and the pool, and another client’s site needed cranes to bring material in and out.

faq.q: How long does a renovation take?
faq.a: Most restorations take three to six weeks, scheduled around Sydney's weather so finishes like glass bead and pebble interiors cure properly. A new build takes longer and approvals sit in front of it.

faq.q: Do you do the pool, or everything around it as well?
faq.a: Both. Interiors, waterline tiling, coping and surrounds, fencing, filtration and the plant room. On one renovation that meant stripping an old pebblecrete interior back, relining the pool and refurbishing the filtration system.

faq.q: Are you licensed, and do you handle council?
faq.a: Sunset Pools is a licensed NSW swimming pool builder, Business License No. 166547C, and their renovations are built to current NSW fencing and filtration laws. Where a job needs council or a certifier, Sunset deal with them — the Bellevue Hill renovation went through council compliance as part of the work.

faq.q: Can you just do the hydraulics for our project?
faq.a: Yes. Sunset are brought in as consultants on other people's pools: hydraulic schematics, plant room layout and sizing, filtration and lighting specifications, heating, electrical loading and projected running costs. Send Ben the drawings and he will come back on what a review would cost.

faq.q: Are you the Sunset Pools on the Gold Coast?
faq.a: No. This Sunset Pools is Sydney-based, independent and family-owned, with no connection to the businesses using the same name in Queensland or the US. Every job on this page is from Sunset Pools' own Sydney portfolio.
